status_definitions.reference: Existing Forge implementation remains the behavioral reference; unchanged release gate applies.
status_definitions.partial: Real native behavior exists, with explicit remaining work; this is not feature parity.
status_definitions.unimplemented: No functional modern adapter; no placeholder registration is counted as support.
status_definitions.complete: Reserved for a family with shared behavior and target/runtime/visual evidence; no family currently has this status.
status_definitions.pending_integration: Historical native implementation may exist, but family integration and current-checkout validation are pending.

inventory_scope: All active generated-catalog registrations plus explicit manual block/item families. Programmable-only textures, internal model templates and retired entries are resources, not additional registered blocks. This is a source inventory, not a runtime registry dump.
